create_metric_logger: create a MetricLogger to log training metrics to a JSONL file with optional wandb integration
log_metrics_with_logger: use the MetricLogger log method to write a metrics dict with timestamps to a JSONL file
monitor_gpu_memory: create a GPUMemoryMonitor to track GPU memory usage, peak stats, and power draw on a CUDA device
upload_metrics_to_wandb: upload training or eval metrics from a checkpoint directory JSONL file to a wandb project
count_model_parameters: call get_num_params on a PyTorch nn.Module to get the total number of parameters
